dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No verified new MT Asana boarding-status change, fresh successful hijacking, or new naval engagement surfaced. Earlier Puntland/Gulf of Aden reporting remains unconfirmed at operational-confidence level. Raw/coupled held 28

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTHERN THAILAND
dashboard_trackers.notes: Multiple sources (Thai PBS World, Nation Thailand, Anadolu, Bangkok Post, Khaosod) confirmed martial-law powers across Narathiwat after the checkpoint assault that killed five rangers and injured six civilians. Troops received expanded search, detention, checkpoint, command, and proportionate lethal-force authorities. military_buildup activated. Raw +5 (20→25), crossing into CRITICAL
